decisions.reason: The custom earmold for in-ear systems fits the firm's established otoplastic business and uses existing production capacity, but it is only mentioned on the website, so the firm's commitment is weaker and the product could be folded into the broader range.

The individual EARsleeve has its own page and complements universal in-the-ear hearing systems, which is core business for an established audiology supplier; there is no sign of a performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The vacuum thermoforming unit is presented on its own page and extends the firm's long-standing equipment line for dental and hearing labs, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while results are still uncertain.
